chapters.label: Live
chapters.text: Barcelona, 1982. Italy, in blue, must beat Brazil, in yellow. Rossi heads in the first! Brazil equalise. Rossi steals a lazy pass and scores! Brazil equalise again. Then a corner is cleared, and Rossi pokes it in. Hat-trick!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch the winner again. The corner is headed out. Tardelli mishits a shot through a crowd of legs. Rossi never takes his eyes off the ball. He reacts first and turns it in!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Rossi's hat-trick knocked Brazil out. Poachers stay alert in the box, watch the ball, and react first!
